author: Cow_Man06
body:
Age: 13

Timezone: EST

Do you have Teamspeak? yep

Do you have Discord? yep

Do you have access to a recording software? yep (if Windows Recorder counts, it actually works really well)



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? No I do not.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? My biggest weakness would be my attitude and how I answer people, I will make sure I show no attitude when moderating though.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? I take lead in most scenarios and can map through difficulties really well. I would consider myself a leader, it's in my brain to take lead when nobody is leading.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? I have served the server as social media and do know the rights and wrongs of avicus.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? I believe when interacting when the community you should not be using vulgar language, not be always sarcastic, be able to be nice to all people, and not get mad when you die. I do believe I have all these skills.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? The three main character traits of a moderator are: kindness, patience, and fairness.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? I would report it to higher officials like a Senior or Admin and if they don't seem to care, I'll report it to an owner.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? I would still report it for it's racism and disrespectful-ism. Even if it's a nightclub channel it does not give you the right to be racist.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would report it to the poster of the thread and a higher official.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? I would immediately report to an Admin/



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? I want to be moderator because of my past actions and how I want to help the server more than hurt it.


What does Avicus mean to you? It's my past childhood, I started playing on my brothers account on Avicus when Walls were the most popular game mode and when there was Nebula. I loved Avicus and was heartbroken when I was banned.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? They could have more moderators on at one time. I have seen hackers on running the server since no moderators were on.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? I choose to apply because, I feel like my past attitude hurt the server so I want to combat that by making the server a better place/


Do you have anything else to add to your application? I have learned.
